announcements.headline: Cancellation - SATSUMA TECHNOLOGY PLC
announcements.insight: Satsuma Technology PLC has been de-listed following court approval of its capital reduction. Shareholders should expect their holdings to be cancelled as per the AGM results.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM and Cancellation of Listing
announcements.insight: Following court approval in September, Satsuma Technology PLC has cancelled its listing. This final step completes the reduction of capital process initiated earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: Directorate change follows the September de-listing update. Shareholders should monitor if this restructuring affects governance of the delisted entity.

announcements.headline: Update on de-listing
announcements.insight: Following court approval in September, this update signals the final steps toward delisting. Shareholders should monitor for the effective date of removal from trading.

announcements.headline: Court approval of reduction of capital
announcements.insight: Court approval finalizes the reduction of capital proposed in June and sanctioned in July. This step precedes the delisting announced earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Update on Proposed Reduction of Capital
announcements.insight: Following the June proposal and July GM result, this update advances the capital reduction process. Shareholders should monitor for the next court sanction step.

announcements.headline: Result of GM
announcements.insight: Satsuma Technology PLC has announced the result of a General Meeting regarding its proposed return of capital and delisting. This follows the June proposal and July corporate updates, marking a critical step in the restructuring process.

announcements.headline: Corporate Update
announcements.insight: The July update follows the June delisting proposal, indicating progression toward the proposed return of capital and removal from trading.

announcements.headline: Monthly Fact Pack — July 2026 Update
announcements.insight: Satsuma Technology PLC is proceeding with a proposed return of capital and delisting. Shareholders should monitor subsequent court meetings for sanction of this transaction.

announcements.headline: Proposed Return of Capital and Delisting
announcements.insight: Satsuma Technology PLC proposes a return of capital and delisting. This likely signals an exit for shareholders as the company ceases to trade publicly.
